test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

She said to me, "The lady you met at the bakery is my sister-in-law."

options.text: She told me that the lady you had met at the bakery was my sister-in-law.
She told me that the lady she met at the bakery was your sister-in-law.
She told me that the lady I had met at the bakery was her sister-in-law.
She told me that the lady I met at the bakery is her sister-in-law.

solution:
The correct answer is **'She told me that the lady I had met at the bakery was her sister-in-law.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Simple Past Tense.
 
• The rule for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The tense of reported speech is changed only when the reporting verb is in the past tense. 
 
• Simple Past Tense&
